title: Goldendoodle & Labradoodle Dog Tags | Salty Dog Tags
description: Funny doodle dog tags for goldendoodles and labradoodles. Laser engraved in Lehi, Utah, so mud, pool water and grooming day can't wipe them. From $12.
blurb: Engraved tags for the dog that looks like a cloud and behaves like a toddler who found the espresso. Whether your doodle is a condo dog or goes full swamp creature every Saturday, these tags are cut into the metal, so they outlast the mop.

hero.alt: Close-up of a laser-engraved dog tag: polished stainless bone with a paw cut-out, engraved WHISKY and a phone number
hero.figcaption: Whisky's actual tag. He's a bulldog, but the laser doesn't care what breed you are.

tough.h2: Pond water, humidity and the groomer can't take it
tough.html:
A doodle doesn't get wet. It absorbs. Pool water, pond water, sprinkler water, the humidity on a "dry" afternoon. All of it soaks into the fur, and the tag sits right in the middle of it for hours.

That's why we engrave instead of print. The words are cut into the tag with a laser, so there's no ink to wash out, fade or peel.

Your dog will still smell like a wet couch cushion. The tag will still be readable.

How engraving holds up →

more.h2: Made by a house with seven bulldogs
more.lead: We're a family in Lehi, Utah with seven English bulldogs and one very busy laser. We wrote the bulldog tags first, from experience. Bulldogs don't swim and doodles don't stop, so the doodle lines come from friends who own a lot of towels.

sayings.h2: 8 doodle sayings for a poodle brain with a retriever heart
sayings.lead: Doodles are smart enough to open the pantry and dumb enough to eat what's inside. The funny part goes on the front; name and number go on the back.
sayings.note: Every line above fits the tag as written. Want your own? Type it in the builder and the preview shows what fits before you pay.

guides.text: Do Dog Tags Wear Off? Engraving vs. Printing, and What Actually Lasts
Stainless vs Aluminum vs Brass Dog Tags

items.q: Will a tag get lost in my doodle's fur?
items.a: A small one can. Doodle coats grow right over little tags, so go with the military or the polished stainless bone, which are big enough to stay visible.

items.q: Will pool water, salt water or humidity ruin an engraved tag?
items.a: No. The words are laser engraved into the metal, not printed on top, so there's no ink to wash off.

items.q: Can I put my doodle's name and my phone number on the tag?
items.a: Yes, that's the standard build. The funny saying goes on the front, and your dog's name and your phone number are engraved on the back.

items.q: Can I write my own doodle saying?
items.a: Yes. Type it into the builder and the preview shows what fits before you pay.

items.q: What happens if the engraving comes out wrong?
items.a: If we mis-engrave it, we remake it free. Tags are engraved and shipped from Lehi, Utah in 1 to 2 business days, then USPS takes 3 to 5 days in transit. US only.
